shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures against a plain ground
horizontal register or band of repeated motifs
quadruped with legs and head rendered in profile
justification: Both surfaces carve profile animals in low relief with at least one horizontal band of repeated forms, but that is a generic correspondence: A shows a naturalistic narrative procession of bearded human attendants leading horned rams past a stylised tree, while B shows no humans and instead a stack of schematic predators, a bird-like creature and abstract signs arranged vertically in tiers on a pillar. The rendering conventions differ sharply, A being modelled and anatomically detailed with patterned fleece and hair, B being flat, angular and emblematic.
